verses.translation: For the end, a Song of a Psalm of resurrection. Shout unto God, all the earth.

translations.ron: Strigaţi lui Dumnezeu tot pământul. Cântaţi numele Lui; daţi slavă laudei Lui.
translations.grk: Εἰς τὸ τέλος, ᾠδὴ ψαλμοῦ ἀναστάσεως. Ἀλαλάξατε τῷ Θεῷ, πᾶσα ἡ γῆ,

verses.translation: O sing praises to his name; give glory to his praise.

translations.ron: Ziceţi lui Dumnezeu: Cât sunt de înfricoşătoare lucrurile Tale! Pentru mulţimea puterii Tale, Te vor linguşi vrăjmaşii Tăi.
translations.grk: ψάλατε δὴ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ, δότε δόξαν αἰνέσει αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: Say unto God, How awful are thy works! through the greatness of thy power thine enemies shall lie to thee.

translations.ron: Tot pământul să se închine Ţie şi să cânte ţie, să cânte numelui Tău.
translations.grk: Εἴπατε τῷ Θεῷ ὡς φοβερὰ τὰ ἔργα σου; ἐν τῷ πλήθει τῆς δυνάμεώς σου ψεύσονταί σε οἱ ἐχθροί σου.

verses.translation: Let all the earth worship thee, and sing to thee; let them sing to thy name. Pause.

translations.ron: Veniţi şi vedeţi lucrurile lui Dumnezeu, înfricoşător în sfaturi mai mult decât fiii oamenilor.
translations.grk: Πᾶσα ἡ γῆ προσκυνησάτωσάν σοι, καὶ ψαλάτωσάν σοι, ψαλάτωσαν τῷ ὀνόματί σου· διάψαλμα.

verses.translation: Come and behold the works of God; he is terrible in his counsels beyond the children of men.

translations.ron: Cel ce preface marea în uscat, prin râu vor trece cu piciorul. Acolo ne vom veseli de El,
translations.grk: Δεῦτε καὶ ἴδετε τὰ ἔργα τοῦ Θεοῦ, φοβερὸς ἐν βουλαῖς ὑπὲρ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

verses.translation: Who turns the sea into dry land; they shall go through the river on foot; there shall we rejoice in him,

translations.ron: De Cel ce stăpâneşte cu puterea Sa veacul. Ochii Lui spre neamuri privesc; cei ce se răzvrătesc, să nu se înalţe întru sine.
translations.grk: Ὁ μεταστρέφων τὴν θάλασσαν εἰς ξηρὰν, ἐν ποταμῷ διελεύσονται ποδί· ἐκεῖ εὐφρανθησόμεθα ἐπʼ αὐτῷ,

verses.translation: who by his power is Lord over the age, his eyes look upon the nations; let not them that provoke him be exalted in themselves. Pause.

translations.ron: Binecuvântaţi neamuri pe Dumnezeul nostru şi faceţi să se audă glasul laudei Lui,
translations.grk: τῷ δεσπόζοντι ἐν τῇ δυναστείᾳ αὐτοῦ τοῦ αἰῶνος· οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὰ ἔθνη ἐπιβλέπουσιν, οἱ παραπικραίνοντες μὴ ὑψούσθωσαν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς· διάψαλμα.

verses.translation: Bless our God, ye Gentiles, and make the voice of his praise to be heard;

translations.ron: Care a dat sufletului meu viaţă şi n-a lăsat să se clatine picioarele mele.
translations.grk: Εὐλογεῖτε ἔθνη τὸν Θεὸν ἡμῶν, καὶ ἀκουτίσατε τὴν φωνὴν τῆς αἰνέσεως αὐτοῦ,

verses.translation: who quickens my soul in life, and does not suffer my feet to be moved.

translations.ron: Că ne-ai cercetat pe noi, Dumnezeule, cu foc ne-ai lămurit pe noi, precum se lămureşte argintul.
translations.grk: τοῦ θεμένου τὴν ψυχήν μου εἰς ζωὴν, καὶ μὴ δόντος εἰς σάλον τοὺς πόδας μου.

verses.translation: For thou, O God, hast proved us; thou hast tried us with fire as silver is tried.

translations.ron: Prinsu-ne-ai pe noi în cursă; pus-ai necazuri pe umărul nostru;
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐδοκίμασας ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς, ἐπύρωσας ἡμᾶς ὡς πυροῦται τὸ ἀργύριον.

verses.translation: Thou broughtest us into the snare; thou laidest afflictions on our back.

translations.ron: Ridicat-ai oameni pe capetele noastre, trecut-am prin foc şi prin apă şi ne-ai scos la odihnă.
translations.grk: Εἰσήγαγες ἡμᾶς εἰς τὴν παγίδα, ἔθου θλίψεις ἐπὶ τὸν νῶτον ἡμῶν,

verses.translation: Thou didst mount men upon our heads; we went through fire and water; but thou broughtest us out into a place of refreshment.

translations.ron: Intra-voi în casa Ta cu arderi de tot, împlini-voi ţie făgăduinţele mele,
translations.grk: ἐπεβίβασας ἀνθρώπους ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς ἡμῶν· διήλθομεν διὰ πυρὸς καὶ ὕδατος, καὶ ἐξήγαγες ἡμᾶς εἰς ἀναψυχήν.

verses.translation: I will go into thine house with whole-burnt-offerings; I will pay thee my vows,

translations.ron: Pe care le-au rostit buzele mele şi le-a grăit gura mea, întru necazul meu.
translations.grk: Εἰσελεύσομαι εἰς τὸν οἶκόν σου ἐν ὁλοκαυτώμασιν, ἀποδώσω σοι τὰς εὐχάς μου,

verses.translation: which my lips framed, and my mouth uttered in my affliction.

translations.ron: Arderi de tot grase voi aduce ţie, cu tămâie şi berbeci; Îţi voi jertfi boi şi ţapi.
translations.grk: ἃς διέστειλε τὰ χείλη μου, καὶ ἐλάλησε τὸ στόμα μου ἐν τῇ θλίψει μου.

verses.translation: I will offer to thee whole-burnt-sacrifices full of marrow, with incense and rams; I will sacrifice to thee oxen with goats. Pause.

translations.ron: Veniţi de auziţi toţi cei ce vă temeţi de Dumnezeu şi vă voi povesti câte a făcut El sufletului meu.

verses.translation: Come, hear, and I will tell, all ye that fear God, how great things he has done for my soul.

translations.ron: Către Dânsul cu gura mea am strigat şi L-am lăudat cu gura mea.

verses.translation: I cried to him with my mouth, and exalted him with my tongue.

translations.ron: Nedreptate de am avut în inima mea să nu mă audă Domnul.

verses.translation: If I have regarded iniquity in my heart, let not the Lord hearken to me.

translations.ron: Pentru aceasta m-a auzit Dumnezeu; luat-a aminte glasul rugăciunii mele.

verses.translation: Therefore God has hearkened to me; he has attended to the voice of my prayer.

translations.ron: Binecuvântat este Dumnezeu, Care n-a depărtat rugăciunea mea şi mila Lui de la mine.

verses.translation: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.
